# MDD Sim Gateway v1.14.2

## 中文

### 0. 重要更新说明

- 本版为**正式版**。VoWiFi 隧道默认 MTU 从 1400 调整为 **1280**，并增加页面设置，以改善部分代理路径上「IMS 已注册但无法呼入」的问题。#251 的同代理测试在调小 MTU 后恢复呼入；具体丢包位置及用户另报的 WebUI 无声问题仍未定位。
- 升级会短暂重启服务和线路。请一起升级 Control、Engine 及宿主编排器或 Hardware 容器。自动更新通道继续保持 **v1.14.0**，本版可手动安装。
- 自动化检查、设置页浏览器交互和隔离 Linux 隧道 MTU 已验证；本版新增修改的跨运营商实卡通话、短信和双向语音仍需用户环境验证。

### 1. 本次小版本更新

- **MTU 可在设置页调整**：进入「系统设置 → 通话与 VoWiFi → VoWiFi 隧道 MTU」，填写 **1280–1500 的整数**。保存不会重启线路；停止再启动需要应用的 VoWiFi 线路后生效。已有有效的 `SWU_TUN_MTU` 环境变量会作为初始值继承，页面保存值优先，不会把手动设置的 1400 强制改成 1280。
- **已注册时也提示代理异常**：正常状态改为「IMS 已注册」。当前实际代理连续两轮未通过 UDP 检测时显示警告、最近检测时间及「重新检测」按钮。正常每 **10 分钟**检测，首次失败后 30 秒复核，告警期间每分钟检查恢复；不自动切换节点或重启线路。小包检测通过不能保证大包或运营商通话正常。
- **来电故障可持续采集**：支持单线路最长 60 分钟采集并标记呼入失败、振铃和接听，使用每次会话独立的地址与呼叫别名；排除认证头、正文、音频、IPsec 密钥及原始抓包。另修复畸形 IKE 消息边界检查和压缩 IPv6 地址的链路本地地址生成。

详见[故障排查](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/blob/v1.14.2/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)、[来电采集](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/blob/v1.14.2/docs/VOWIFI_RECORDING.md)和[代理提示](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/blob/v1.14.2/docs/PROXY_HEALTH.md)。

### 2. 当前大版本更新

保留 v1.14 的设备自定义名称、移动端布局改进及 eSIM、SIM 桥接和国家出口恢复。本版重建 amd64、arm64 Engine，并提供完整组件镜像、源码包、Compose 文件及校验和。

## English

### 0. Important notes

- This is a **stable release**. The default VoWiFi tunnel MTU changes from 1400 to **1280**, with a UI setting to improve cases where IMS stays registered but incoming calls fail on some proxy paths. Same-proxy testing in #251 restored incoming calls after lowering the MTU; the exact loss point and the separately reported silent WebUI audio remain unresolved.
- Upgrading briefly restarts services and lines. Update Control, Engine, and the host orchestrator or Hardware container together. Automatic update channels remain at **v1.14.0**; this release is available for manual installation.
- Automated checks, browser interaction with Settings, and isolated Linux tunnel-MTU behavior have been verified. Cross-carrier real-SIM calls, SMS, and two-way audio for the new changes still require validation in users' environments.

### 1. Changes in this patch release

- **Adjust MTU in Settings**: open Settings → Calls & VoWiFi → VoWiFi tunnel MTU and enter an **integer from 1280 to 1500**. Saving does not restart lines; stop and start the VoWiFi lines that should use the value. Valid existing `SWU_TUN_MTU` environment values are inherited initially, and saved UI values take precedence. An explicit value of 1400 is not forcibly replaced with 1280.
- **Warn about proxy failures while registered**: the normal status now says “IMS registered.” Two consecutive failed UDP checks of the actual current proxy show a warning, the last check time, and a recheck button. Healthy exits are checked every **10 minutes**, a first failure is confirmed after 30 seconds, and warned exits are rechecked every minute. Checks do not switch nodes or restart lines. Passing a small-packet probe does not establish large-packet or carrier-call availability.
- **Record incoming-call faults**: opt in to up to 60 minutes of per-line recording and mark failed, ringing, and answered calls, with session-specific address and call aliases. Authentication headers, bodies, audio, IPsec keys, and raw captures are excluded. Also fixes malformed IKE-message boundary checks and link-local address generation for compressed IPv6 addresses.

See [troubleshooting](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/blob/v1.14.2/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md), [recording instructions](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/blob/v1.14.2/docs/VOWIFI_RECORDING.md), and [proxy-health notes](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/blob/v1.14.2/docs/PROXY_HEALTH.md).

### 2. Current major release

Includes v1.14 custom device names, mobile layout improvements, and eSIM, SIM bridge, and country-exit recovery. This release rebuilds amd64 and arm64 Engines and includes all component images, source, Compose files, and checksums.
